title: A run's cut-off and creation, to the microsecond
assertion: A service line whose created_at equals the run's own created_at (loaded at the instant of the transaction that creates the run) is the run's at creation and in the price job alike: its period is not refused as holding no service line, nor as nothing mapped (MAP-07), and creation judges exactly the plans and dates the job prices. Every time a run is judged against is compared in Postgres, to the microsecond, never as a millisecond JS Date: a mapping made at the run's own instant is not a reason to re-run it, while one made after is, and a complete run with no line created before the location's last save, within the same millisecond, is listed as priced before the location changed
noFileReason: No file of its own: PRC-19's file, with lines and times the tests set.
